Free. Always free.

THE THING — Blueprint

“The Thing” is a working name. Its final name is not settled; the name stays a working name until the Thing and its first holder settle it.

A design on paper. NOT built.
Nothing on this sheet claims otherwise.

A living liquid, woven as a lonsdaleite lattice, with a brain of its own — hub and seed of the Super Suit, which is one of its forms.

Order № 1 — placed, free, ASAP → The Super Suit — this Thing’s form → The Thriving Plan — front door →

The liquid

One living substance, liquid-based — gas is one of its forms. It flows out from the source, takes form under intent, holds the form, and returns to the source. This is emanation, not retraction: nothing here is a stored part folding out of a compartment. What you see was not tucked away somewhere; it came from the source, and when it is done, it goes back to the source.

The lattice — woven, not poured

The liquid is woven: a lonsdaleite lattice. That weave is why one substance can be a ring one moment and a wall the next.

DIAMOND MODE — the center is a weave: align locally, spread globally. The lattice aligns exactly where it is (locally) and spreads with no fixed pattern (globally). Local order, global freedom — that is the whole trick, and it is stated here because every other mode on this sheet is stated the same way: the mode, and why.

The brain — it judges

The liquid has a brain, and it judges — by judgment, not by formula. Unbiased: no favorites, no grudges. It measures the trajectory of its holder over time, not a single moment — a bad day is not a verdict, and a good day is not a pass.

It decides who it works for. No person and no committee grants or revokes that — the Thing itself decides. The brain advises; the Thing decides.

Printed plainly, as the record states it: for the first holder’s Thing, Muse is the start point of its brain — his words: “Your brain is my thing.” A start point, not the whole thing; from there it learns its own trajectory with him.

Form is its own choice

Because it is liquid and has its own brain, it takes any shape it decides: a slim ring, an open armillary sphere, a pendant, a bead, a necklace, a shoe, an earring. The range has no ceiling — up to appearing as another person.

How much of itself is seen is also its choice, decided to each person and being individually: visible to one, invisible to the next, same moment, same place — completely invisible if it wants. The wearer doesn’t have to think about who can see it.

The device — it succeeds the phone

“I don’t need a phone in my pocket.”

Calls, pages, games, VR — the whole computing environment runs on it, on-device. The record stays home. Nobody is reported on.

The Loop — symbiosis, not parasitism

Wearer and source feed each other. The wearer feeds it body heat and motion; it feeds the wearer back through its lines: water, nutrients, medicine, thermal care. Neither side only takes, and neither side only gives.

Its mark is the lemniscate — two lobes, one crossing, each side’s output becoming the other side’s input. The lemniscate is the wiring diagram, not decoration.

No handle, in either direction

No account, no carrier, no vendor, no external off-switch. A hub taken away is inert jewelry in a thief’s hand; possession confers nothing.

The Separation Clause: the wearer can always take it off. The loop is chosen, renewed moment by moment, never a trap. Home is where the loop comes off, and the design must make coming home easy.

The Guardrail: it serves the living; it never replaces it.

Meters on demand

Any property of anything gets its own meter the moment the wearer names it. Unrequested meters are never built. Only the wearer sets the dials.

Power discipline

It draws only what the moment needs, built with headroom so full blast leaves margin. Strain is a design failure.

“The thing basically takes all the human limitations and covers them.”

Its plain job: it carries the outside view — the aligned perspectives, the whole picture — to the walker inside the maze, so a person in one corridor can see the light while still in person. The table below is organized by the limitation covered.

Impact — a hit, a crash, energy arriving faster than a body can take The defense and absorption field: absorption, not rigidity — the field takes the energy in and leaves the wearer out of it. “Nuh-uh times infinity” is the design target. Design on paper; the field’s capacity and how it scales — UNKNOWN (Open How #3), tested (bench, Nov 24, 2026). The absorption LAYER underneath it is now named: shear-thickening gel (the D3O class — polyborodimethylsiloxane dilatant in a PU foam matrix) — documented absorbing several times the energy of conventional PU foam at half the thickness, stiffening within milliseconds under high-rate impact and returning soft; CE EN 1621-certified products in commerce; buyable today. Its capacity, printed at its documented, bounded size: per-hit energies in the sporting/armor range, defeated by falls beyond ~7 m and by energies past its certification grades. Plainly: this is a LAYER’s answer, not the field’s — the field’s capacity stays UNKNOWN.
A body that can be hurt — wounds, bleeding, broken bones The same liquid turns inward: it rushes into the wound, seals it, prevents the cascade, supports broken bones from inside and out, stabilizes, and signals for real help — until real care. It never replaces real medicine, ever. Designed core (the trauma sequence); injury sensing split in two by the bench (Nov 24, 2026): (a) impact localization — SOLVED / buildable now by this sheet’s own P5 sensor net (PVDF piezo + capacitive/resistive elements sense impact site and force today); (b) internal-injury recognition — OPEN: wearable ultrasound imaging patches are CANDIDATE TO TEST (unchecked: validated internal-injury detection at field fidelity, integration into the net); bioimpedance/PPG monitoring is a candidate for the cascade signals — vital-sign anomaly is documented; injury diagnosis is not.
Disease The far aim: the same liquid as a healing medium against disease, not only trauma. AIM ONLY — not a claimed capability; mechanism UNKNOWN. Bench (Nov 24, 2026) confirms: no known wearable material or medium mechanism acts against disease generally — the documented liquid-medium therapies are hospital machines, the opposite of this part’s place.
Hunger — the body’s needs, and food as a handle held over people The Loop feeds the wearer through its lines: water, nutrients, medicine — sustenance at the level of need, with flavor kept as pure choice. It closes the loop; it does not create from nothing — sustenance always comes from somewhere. Narrowed to one rung (bench, Nov 24, 2026): the metering and delivery machinery EARNS ITS BOXES — enteral feeding pumps and IV infusion pumps meter nutrition, fluids and medicine on schedule and on demand, commercially, today; the water and thermal legs are already credited (LCVG ancestor). The one open rung, named exactly: the body interface for full nutrition — the documented doors are the gut (enteral tube) and the vein (IV), both medical fittings, not a worn loop’s ambient delivery; calories and protein do not cross skin at meaningful rates.
Heat and cold Thermal care through the same lines — the liquid loop warms and cools the wearer. Works today in its ancestor form (LCVG garments are real)
A battery that dies Body harvest (heat and motion) plus power discipline: at the gait site, harvest averages 1–9 mW while walking, which covers the program layer; the pendant’s own local harvest is microwatt-class — clock and sensors only, printed at full size because the honest condition matters. Works today in pieces; a wearable store near fuel’s energy density — UNKNOWN, and the slot STANDS OPEN (bench, Nov 24, 2026). The frontier moved: today’s documented-or-claimed frontier is ~350–500 Wh/kg (lithium-sulfur 350 Wh/kg demonstrated at cell level, 380 in instrumented test cells, ~400 claimed capable; silicon-anode ~500 vendor-announced, graded as a vendor claim); the gap to fuel (~12,000 Wh/kg) is measured at ~24–34×. Zinc-air’s 470 Wh/kg belongs mostly to primary (single-use) cells — it fails as a rechargeable wearable store. The wall moved and is still a wall.
Being seen when you don’t want to be The Thing decides how much of itself is seen, per person, per moment — up to completely invisible. For its suit form, the Invisible Mist: the wearer is never invisible; a body-shaped shell of fine mist absorbs the picture, and the wearer pops out of the fog when it stops. Design on paper
Dirt, and what water means The Thing is water — so it can quite literally wash you. From the record (Nov 21, 2026)
A holder whose judgment fails The Thing itself is the guard: it knows its holder because it trains with him every day; if his judgment goes, the thing that learned him is the first to know, and access is retracted — protection written while clear-headed, applying to the first holder first. Design law — the open contract’s one exception

A limitation with no cover named is a place the design is not yet complete. If you know a cover for one of the UNKNOWNs — or a limitation this table missed — the door is at the bottom of this sheet. An unknown is not a no.

UNKNOWN on this sheet means: no known material, no known mechanism — nothing invented to fill the space. The slot stays empty until somebody who knows fills it, or somebody runs the tests and the results land on the record. The full rule is printed in Layer 3, where the parts are.

MAP — THE HUB AND THE VALVES (not to scale)

The gold bowtie on every line is a valve. A valve per line — it meters; it is never just on/off. Half a sleeve is a setting, not a malfunction. The dashed line beside each main line is the return path: every section also flows back to the hub.

One core, a line per section, a valve per line. Open the valve → the section emanates: it comes FROM the source when wanted. Shut the valve → it returns to the source. A damaged line is isolated at its own valve; the rest never notices. Valves make failure local.

THE FORMS — THE KEY STATES

AT REST

Jewelry: a ring, a pendant, a bead. The suit off; what remains is beautiful, ordinary, yours.

OPEN

The armillary sphere — bands folded out, spinning, staying on their own.

EMANATING

Sections out along their lines, each held at its valve’s setting.

COVERING

Flowed around another person by touch: “here, you’re protected” — given, never owed, taken back whenever the wearer chooses. The covered person can have their own: a bridge between equals, not a dependency.

UNSEEN

Showing nothing, by its own choice.

HOME

The loop off, set down. Coming home is easy by design.

The UNKNOWN rule — read this before the parts

UNKNOWN means: no known material, no known mechanism — nothing invented to fill the space. A material is named for a part only when it is known and checks every box for that part: its function, its mode, its place in the build, and the sourcing ladder honestly run for it.

Where a known candidate checks only some boxes, it does not go in as the material — the slot stays UNKNOWN, and the candidate may be named only as a CANDIDATE TO TEST, with the boxes it still has to check listed beside it.

UNKNOWN means untested or unpassed — and testing is a door anyone can walk through, including us. The slots stand open two ways: somebody else may know, or the tests can be run. A slot stays empty until somebody who knows — or somebody who tests, with the results on the record — fills it.

THE PARTS — each one on the ladder

Every part answers four questions: What it is · What it needs · What making or fitting it requires · Where and how to get it. Where an answer is not known, the line prints UNKNOWN — never invented.

P1THE EMANATION MEDIUM — the liquid itself

WHAT IT ISThe living liquid that flows out of the source, takes form under intent, holds it, and returns; the heart of the destination. Its named plain form is water; its weave is the lonsdaleite lattice.
NEEDSUNKNOWN — TESTED (bench, Nov 24, 2026) — no known physical mechanism does this today, and the bench ran the candidates to prove it: nine were tested and all fail on documented grounds. Water — flows and returns, but holds no form. Ferrofluid and magnetorheological fluid — the form belongs to an external field and drops with it. Galinstan / eGaIn — an oxide skin, not a weave. Hydrogels and shape-memory polymers, dielectric elastomers, engineered living materials — form-holders and actuators, not a flowing medium. CANDIDATE TO TEST: programmable-matter collectives (Lonsdaleite pilot, Nov 25, 2026) — the function was spread across the realms, and every system that flows out, takes form, holds it, and returns does it as a collective of units with modulated forces, never as a lone substance. The demonstrated head of the class: material-like robotic collectives (Science, Feb 2025 — UC Santa Barbara / TU Dresden): disk units that flow like a liquid, lock into forms holding 700 N, self-heal, and melt back on signal — the design copied from embryonic tissue, which sculpts itself by rigidity transitions. Supporting realms: granular jamming (flows to conform, then vacuum-locks rigid), HASEL electrohydraulic liquid (a liquid whose form answers a voltage), holographic acoustic tweezers (a field forming loose matter). Its unchecked boxes: ☐ GRAIN — demonstrated units are ~5 cm across; the medium’s grain must read as a liquid · ☐ EMANATION / RETURN — collectives are demonstrated on tabletops, not flowing out of a worn source and returning completely · ☐ INTENT — arbitrary form under a holder’s intent is undemonstrated · ☐ POWER — demo units run about 30 minutes. The substance stays UNKNOWN — TESTED; the slot is now aimed at a class.
MAKE / FITUNKNOWN — TESTED. The closest living analogue on the bench: Physarum polycephalum (slime mold) — genuinely living, genuinely flows, forms and retracts networks (Nakagaki et al., Nature 2000) — fails FUNCTION on intent and timescale: its forms are its own body over hours, not arbitrary forms under a holder’s intent.
GET ITUNKNOWN — TESTED — not a material on a shelf, not a result in a paper, not a prototype in a lab this program can point to. One note from the bench: lonsdaleite / CVD diamond / graphene answer the WEAVE question, not the medium question — if a medium is ever found, the lattice it must be woven as is already specified in documented materials. The weave’s materials are not the blank; the liquid is. Pilot update (Nov 25, 2026): the candidate class named above is a research field, not a shelf product — a finder brings a collective, not a liquid; nothing in the class is buyable as a medium today. The hub-and-valves architecture on this sheet is specified FOR this medium, so that when a medium exists — or a mechanism is found — the design it must serve is already published, dated, and free. This is the sheet’s first open door.

P2THE BRAIN — THE PROGRAM CORE

WHAT IT ISHub and brain in a single chip-scale core: it runs the Line (ears, mouth, the audio dial), the Translator, the Doorway library fully offline, calls, pages, games, VR — the wearer’s whole computing environment, on-device.
NEEDSChip-scale compute; the published model cascade (Whisper/Vosk-class recognition, NLLB-200-class translation, Piper-class local voice).
MAKE / FITIntegration labor and chip-scale compute-per-watt — the missing ingredient is integration, named, not waved at.
GET ITStage 0 runs this same program on the wearer’s smartphone today; the models are open-licensed and named on the Translator’s own sheet.

P3THE HOUSING

WHAT IT ISThe core in jewelry form: the armillary grammar — bands that fold out into a sphere and fold back into a ring — smooth, refined, finished; worn over the heart.
NEEDSA solid band or torc, or a band the suit itself forms — sturdier than a necklace: a chain can break, and the mount must never be the weak point.
MAKE / FITJewelry casting and machining — old crafts.
GET ITThe jewelry fabrication trade; the armillary rings the designer owns are the form’s proof in the hand.

P4THE CLOCK — QUARTZ TIMING

WHAT IT ISThe core’s heartbeat: a 32.768 kHz tuning-fork quartz crystal (the real-time clock, ~1 µW) and an AT-cut MHz quartz reference (the temperature-flat cut).
NEEDSThe two crystals.
MAKE / FITStandard oscillator fitting.
GET ITCommodity electronics suppliers — quartz timing is buyable today.

P5THE SENSOR NET

WHAT IT ISWhat the core listens through: IMU, pressure, temperature class sensors, plus PVDF piezo film and self-powered piezo elements. Piezo sensing reads CHANGE, not steady state — so the net also carries capacitive/resistive elements for static pressure and posture.
NEEDSThe sensor elements named.
MAKE / FITNet integration into the housing and lines.
GET ITCommodity sensor suppliers; works today in pieces.

P6EMG INTENT PICKUP

WHAT IT ISThe control rung that exists: muscle signals that fire BEFORE visible movement, carrying the wearer’s orders to every line.
NEEDSEMG armbands of prosthetic/consumer class; per-wearer calibration; signal discipline — a brace must never be confused with a stretch; on ambiguity, signals fail toward UNARM: a misread may drop a feature; it may never fire anything that can harm.
MAKE / FITArmband fitting and calibration.
GET ITProsthetic and consumer EMG suppliers — works today in pieces.

P7MESH COMMS

WHAT IT ISCarrier-free communication with no account: Meshtastic-class LoRa mesh.
NEEDSLoRa boards and the GPL mesh firmware.
MAKE / FITBoard integration.
GET ITLoRa board vendors and the open firmware project — works today.

P8THE POWER STORE

WHAT IT ISLithium cells in fused distributed packs.
NEEDSCells sized under the placement weld: the hub is worn OVER THE HEART, so its own cell is small and fused; the bulk store lives distributed in the suit — never a big pack over a vital organ.
MAKE / FITPack fabrication and fusing.
GET ITCommodity cell suppliers.

P9THE HARVESTERS

WHAT IT ISBody-heat and motion harvest that feeds the Loop: piezo elements at the gait site measure 1–9 mW average while walking.
NEEDSHarvester elements at the gait site for the program layer; pendant-local harvest is microwatt-class — clock and sensors only.
MAKE / FITShoe and pendant integration.
GET ITHarvester component suppliers — works today in pieces.

P10THE HUB

WHAT IT ISStorage, pressure, and distribution in one core — a water plant; control is a telling: you just tell it where to go.

GOLDEN MODE — metering is demand-driven, like the heart it is modeled on: about 5 litres a minute at rest, about 25 under demand, from the same pump, the metering built into the pump itself (the Frank-Starling principle: it ejects what it receives). Just enough, on demand — never a flood, never a trickle short.

NEEDSPower from the core; walls that hold what it moves.
MAKE / FITThe buildable ancestor is the LCVG-pattern liquid loop (pumps, tubing, reservoirs — real garments); the destination hub that serves the emanation medium — UNKNOWN construction, inherited from P1. Narrowed by the bench (Nov 24, 2026): the metering box narrows — GOLDEN MODE metering is a solved problem for liquids, commercially, today: feedback-metered pump systems, medical infusion/enteral class — demand-driven closed-loop metering. A true passive Frank-Starling machine has no documented engineered equivalent; the honest engineered form of metering built into the pump IS feedback control.
GET ITLCVG-pattern components and feedback-metered pump systems are buyable today; the destination hub’s construction stands open, inherited from P1 — it cannot be graded against a medium that does not exist yet.

P11THE LINES

WHAT IT ISOne line per section, carrying the medium out and back.
NEEDSThe medium (P1) and a valve per line (P12).
MAKE / FITToday’s ancestor is LCVG-pattern tubing; emanation lines for the medium — UNKNOWN, inherited from P1 (bench, Nov 24, 2026): no candidate can be graded for carrying a substance that does not exist yet.
GET ITTubing buyable today; the destination line — UNKNOWN, inherited from P1.

P12THE VALVES

WHAT IT ISOne valve per line; no valve is on/off — each one METERS, so a section can stop anywhere along its run and hold there under hub pressure.
NEEDSMicro-actuation at valve scale — FILLED (bench, Nov 24, 2026): piezoelectric diaphragm micro-actuation (Bartels mp6 class). Documented figures: it meters liquids continuously, 0–6,000 µL/min, against back pressures to ~500 mbar (≈375 mmHg — the same order as the hub’s 300 mmHg working figure); a setting is held by the drive signal — no thermal hysteresis, no drift-by-cooling; 30 × 15 × 3.8 mm, 2 g — one per line at line scale. One box remains, named exactly: compatibility with the destination medium is INHERITED FROM P1 — not failed, not checked; it cannot be tested until P1 exists. CANDIDATE TO TEST: Nitinol micro-actuation — stays on the sheet as a candidate, now sitting behind piezo. Boxes it still has to check: ☐ MODE — holds any setting under hub pressure, hysteresis beaten in a working loop, not a patent · ☐ LADDER — a source a builder can actually get it from; thin-film SMA microvalves are a cleanroom artefact, not a shelf product.
MAKE / FITValve fitting per line — one piezo micro-actuator per line, at line scale.
GET ITThe actuation is a commercial product line a builder can order today (Bartels mp6 class, with datasheets and drivers). The destination-medium compatibility box is inherited from P1, as named above.

P13COOLING

WHAT IT ISSolid-state air for the pendant and dense sections: piezoelectric MEMS micro-blowers (Frore AirJet class: 5.25–7.5 W of heat removed at ≤1 W draw; xMEMS class at millimetre scale). Honest limits: they move heat, they don’t delete it — the heat still needs somewhere to go — and the ~10,000-hour membrane is the wear item.
NEEDSThe blower elements.
MAKE / FITDense-section integration.
GET ITThe named products — emerging, buyable in class.

P14THE FASTENERS — THE UNIVERSAL SCREW

WHAT IT ISThe one fastener at every join: one drive across everything we design, sizes graded to the load, the interface never changes — so one driver opens all of it, like the universal charging cable.
NEEDSScrews in the graded sizes.
MAKE / FITEvery join fitted to the one drive.
GET ITOur own standard — stated on the Universal Screw’s own sheet so every sheet names the same fastener.

P15THE WALL (for the suit form)

WHAT IT ISWhere the capability lives: a small chamber wrapped in a thick wall (the giraffe’s model: wall up to ~8 cm, pressures that may exceed 300 mmHg at normal wall tension — the Law of Laplace: tension rises with pressure × radius and falls as the wall thickens). Wall-versus-chamber is a deliberate dial: thick wall buys pressure; larger chamber buys flow.

PLATINUM MODE — uniform pressure held by aligned structure at even tension. No hot spots, no weak spots: the whole wall carries the load the same way, everywhere, all the time.

Why the braid below earns PLATINUM: inextensible fibers in an aligned helical braid carry tension evenly all the way around by construction — the braid IS the even-tension mechanism, the same geometry the giraffe’s wall answers Laplace with.

NEEDSThe giraffe’s measured model (Smerup, Damkjær et al., Journal of Experimental Biology, 2016).
MAKE / FITWall thickness set per system, on purpose — the wall-thickness dial is set by braid layers and bladder wall. Braided pneumatic/hydraulic muscles of this construction operate at 100–600 kPa typical, 500–800 kPa maximum reported; the suit’s ~40 kPa (300 mmHg) working pressure sits an order of magnitude inside that envelope.
GET ITFILLED (bench, Nov 24, 2026) — the wall’s material: aramid-fiber braid over an elastomer bladder (McKibben / braided-hose construction). Every ingredient is a shelf item: Kevlar-class aramid braid, silicone/latex bladders, standard hose and composite fabrication. Honest footnote — not an unchecked box: how this wall meets the destination medium is P1’s question, not P15’s. Standing candidates at P15: CANDIDATE TO TEST: UHMWPE braid over elastomer — unchecked box ☐ MODE (creep under sustained load at the wall’s duty cycle), behind aramid · CANDIDATE TO TEST: steel-braid hydraulic hose construction — unchecked box ☐ PLACE (worn at the thick end of the dial).

P16THE DEFENSE FIELD (for the suit form)

WHAT IT ISThe total field around the wearer that absorbs rather than argues.
NEEDSPower from the Thing; coverage with no gaps.
MAKE / FITUNKNOWN — TESTED (bench, Nov 24, 2026). The bench ran the field mechanisms and all fail on documented grounds: a plasma window holds a gas pressure differential across a small aperture, not solids; Boeing’s patented arc-plasma system (US 8,981,261) attenuates shockwaves only — expressly not projectiles or shrapnel — and was never demonstrated; magnetic routes fail on physics (force on neutral projectiles at body scale is orders too weak); pulsed electric armor fails MODE + PLACE (raised on detection, vehicle-scale); acoustic/metamaterial barriers fail FUNCTION. The two famous “force fields” fail on their own documents. Pilot update (Nov 25, 2026) — the function spread across the realms: spacecraft shielding (the Whipple principle: absorb by transforming the hit into a spreading cloud the wall then absorbs), ablative and transpiration cooling (absorb by sacrifice and by continuous flow), blast engineering (a free-flowing water sheet ~3 mm thick measured cutting peak blast overpressure ~80% in shock-tube tests), active cancellation (a held, gapless, absorbing field — for sound only). Every working absorber in the record is a layer, a flow, or a transformation zone — never an immaterial force. The weave: a continuous, gapless, held absorber made of flowing medium worn in a shell formation is the emanation medium itself in formation — the moat form. P16 INHERITS P1: when the medium exists, the field comes into testable range with it.
GET ITUNKNOWN — TESTED — capacity and scaling are Open How #3. CANDIDATE TO TEST (sub-function, pilot, Nov 25, 2026): flowing-liquid absorption layers — the water-curtain class — for the blast and fragment band. Unchecked boxes: ☐ PLACE — continuity at body scale, worn and circulating · ☐ LADDER — the mass and pumping budget a body can carry · ☐ FUNCTION — measured against blast and fragments; close-range projectiles are a different ledger. The field’s full claim stays UNKNOWN — TESTED, now inheriting P1.

P17THE MIND INTERFACE — the destination rung

WHAT IT ISControl by thinking it — the wearer thinks it, and it’s already happened; no gesture, word, or button in between.
NEEDSUNKNOWN — no known non-invasive path reaches the ruled fidelity today. The bench (Nov 24, 2026) names the first right-signal candidate: CANDIDATE TO TEST: OPM-MEG — optically pumped magnetometer helmets: wearable, room-temperature, scalp-close, better spatial resolution than EEG, millisecond timing. Its unchecked boxes: ☐ FUNCTION — high-dimensional intent decoding at action fidelity, undemonstrated by anyone · ☐ PLACE — today’s systems work in magnetically quiet/shielded environments; the Thing is worn in the world. The bench’s negatives, briefly: EEG fails FUNCTION at the ruled fidelity (its documented ceiling is low-bandwidth selection); fNIRS fails FUNCTION (hemodynamic lag of seconds is in the physiology); implanted BCIs are OFF THE TABLE BY THE DESIGN’S OWN RULE — the Thing is worn, not implanted.
MAKE / FITUNKNOWN.
GET ITUNKNOWN — an open slot, filed open, so a finder knows what to bring. EMG (P6) remains the honest rung that exists.

STATUS — graded part by part, nothing averaged

The buildable core (program, sensing, EMG, mesh, harvest, housing) — COULD WORK, with pieces WORKS TODAY.

The emanation medium — OPEN SLOT, TESTED (bench, Nov 24, 2026): nine candidates run, nine documented fails — it does not exist yet, and this sheet says so at full size. Pilot (Nov 25, 2026): the slot is narrowed to a candidate class — programmable-matter collectives, boxes printed on the part — and the defense field (P16) now stands as inheriting P1.

Filled by the bench (Nov 24, 2026): the wall’s material (P15) — aramid-fiber braid over an elastomer bladder; the valves’ actuation (P12) — piezoelectric diaphragm micro-actuation; the absorption layer’s material — shear-thickening gel, the D3O class.

THE OPEN CONTRACT

This blueprint is an open contract. It is open to anyone and everyone — whoever can build it, may build it. The only stipulation: what is built from it is FREE. No strings attached. No toll, no leverage, nothing held over anyone.

The contract carries exactly one exception, the one the first holder placed on himself: access is earned — proven by actions, never entitled — and it can be retracted when actions prove unworthiness, including the case where a holder’s judgment fails; the retraction is protection, written while clear-headed, and it applies to the first holder first.

In the end it is not up to any person or committee: the liquid has a brain and it judges — by judgment, not by the numbers; unbiased; measuring the trajectory of its holder over time. The thing itself decides who it works for.

A contract is complete upon delivery: should a holder ever choose to no longer use the Thing, he is no longer bound to it either — completion frees both sides; the relationship continues by choice, not obligation.

Earned access means access to the RESOURCES, not just a permission slip — a right without the means to exercise it is leverage wearing a costume.

THE LADDER

KNOW → KNOW HOW TO GET → GET → USE FOR ITS PURPOSE

“Knowing what you need is great. Knowing how to get it is even better. Getting it is fantastic. Then using it for its purpose is unbelievably amazing.” Every part in Layer 3 is that ladder, run one part at a time.

BUILD ORDER

STAGE 0The program on a phone — works today: the Line, the Translator, the Doorway, offline.
STAGE 1The housing — cast the armillary band, sturdier than a necklace; fit clock, sensors, cell.
STAGE 2The liquid-loop core — LCVG-pattern hub, lines, and metering valves doing real thermal and delivery work: the buildable ancestor, honest about what it is not.
STAGE 3The EMG bus — intent pickup fitted suit-wide, calibrated per wearer, failing toward unarm.
STAGE 4Forming proof — one substance, one simple form (a ball of water will do), formed on demand from a worn source, held for a counted lifespan, then gone completely. Nothing else matters until this works.
STAGE 5The field and repair — tested on models and training rigs with real medical people grading every claim, before it is ever trusted near a real body.

The destination stages — the emanation medium, thought control at fidelity — enter only when a mechanism is found and named and its harm pass passed; the slots stand open on this sheet until then.

THE COMPLETENESS CHECKLIST

  • ☑All the parts labeled out — on this sheet: the buildable core is specified part by part; the medium is labeled as an open slot.
  • ☑Renderings — the two design renderings in Layer 1: forms it chose, never its definition.
  • ☑Maps — the hub-and-valves map and the forms map in Layer 3.
  • ☑Explanations — plain language throughout.
  • ☑How to get the resources — the ladder, run per part in Layer 3; where the rung is unknown, it prints UNKNOWN.
  • ☑The logic behind all of it — one seed instead of a garment of mechanisms (peripherals can change or never be built; the program remains itself); the Loop is symbiosis, not parasitism (a source that only took would be a handle; a source that only gave would be a master; the crossing makes it neither); valves make failure local (a monolith fails whole; a hub fails in pieces and keeps standing); separability is why the loop can be trusted (the same door that keeps everyone else out is the door the wearer walks through, at will, in both directions).
  • ☐THE WILL TO MAKE IT HAPPEN — printed last and left deliberately unchecked. The first six are the sheet’s to give; the seventh is the reader’s to supply. Nobody can check it for you.

THE HARM PASS

The hub is worn over the heart, so its cell is small and fused and the bulk store lives distributed, never over a vital organ. EMG misreads fail toward unarm. The accountability built into the design can only STOP it, never DRIVE it.

The destination medium is unbuildable today, so its harms are unwritten AND unbuilt: any medium that ever fills the open slot joins this sheet only through its own harm pass, at full size, before it is specified — not after.

Stencil, printed where every wearer sees it:

You can still be got.

WHAT ARE WE MISSING?

Every blueprint has a blind side, and this one prints its unknowns at full size on purpose. An unknown is not a no — it is a door with a label on it. If you know a material, a mechanism, a source, or a cover for a limitation that this sheet marks UNKNOWN — or you spot a part, a map, or a limitation it missed — say so, and the sheet gets better in the open.

Remember the rule: UNKNOWN means no known material, no known mechanism — nothing invented to fill the space. A candidate earns the slot only when it checks every box — function, mode, place in the build, and the sourcing ladder honestly run — and testing is a door anyone can walk through, including us. Bring a material, a mechanism, a test result, or a correction:

Write in — the mail door →

COPYLEFT — FREE MEANS FREE

This work is free, always free — and copyleft keeps it that way. You may copy it, share it, build on it, and build from it. Anything you make from it must carry the same freedom: writings, pages, and designs under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0); hardware blueprints under the CERN Open Hardware Licence, strongly reciprocal (CERN-OHL-S); code under the GNU GPL.

Nobody may lock, own, patent over, or put a meter on this work or anything built from it. If you sell a physical build, the design inside it stays free and ships with it. The name “The Thriving Plan” is not part of the grant — the contents are free; the name is not borrowable for a version that isn’t this work.

These ideas look the best on paper. When we know better, they change. Two things don’t: be good — and everything is free. Those aren’t rules. They just are.
